subject: Discovery follow-up: demo scheduling and attendee confirmation

Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - next steps

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side:
- We’re evaluating multi-tenant inference for customer-facing features (recommendations + search).
- Primary goals: consistent p95 latency under 500ms and predictable monthly cost.
- Must have: VPC/private deploy option and SOC 2 evidence.

We’d love to move to a technical deep-dive/demo next week with our infra lead (Priya) and one backend engineer (Tariq).

Looking at availability: we’re free Tue 6/9 10-11am PT, Wed 6/10 1-3pm PT, or Fri 6/12 9-11am PT. Which time works for you and who from Redwood should join?

Also can you share a short agenda and any pre-read?

Thanks,
Alex

Head of Data Platforms
Nimbus Analytics

1) 5m intro + goals alignment
